issues.detail: One bubble (Qatar, 36.25 t CO2/capita) falls outside the mandated ylim [0,30] and is clipped; this is disclosed by an on-panel note rather than hidden.
Panel-4 x-axis label pads the required granularity words with the words 'Geographic Granularity (...)'; all four required levels (State, County, City, Postal Code) literally appear.

Panels 2/3/6 mix global, India-steel and U.S. data sources; the suptitle frames this as a multi-dimensional perspective, so the mixture is intentional but means cross-panel comparisons are not like-for-like.
